title: The Frozen Knight
story: Black's king is still in the centre. Pin the knight to the king — it cannot move at all!
pgn: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. c3 Nf6 4. d3 d6 5. Nbd2 g6 6. h3 Bg7 7. d4 exd4 8. cxd4 h5 *

title: Rook on the Open File
story: White's knight jumped to e5 — but the white king is still in the centre. Pin the knight with your rook!
pgn: 1. e4 e6 2. d4 d5 3. exd5 exd5 4. Nf3 Bd6 5. Bd3 Nf6 6. Bg5 O-O 7. Nbd2 h6 8. Bh4 c6 9. Ne5 *

title: The Classic Bishop Pin
story: The white knight on f3 stands right in front of the queen. Pin it — now it cannot jump anywhere!
pgn: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. Bc4 Bc5 4. d3 Nf6 5. Nc3 d6 6. a3 O-O 7. Ba2 Re8 8. O-O *

title: Queen Pins from the Edge
story: Black's king lingers in the centre. Your queen pins the knight from the side of the board!
pgn: 1. d4 d5 2. c4 e6 3. Nc3 c5 4. cxd5 exd5 5. Nf3 Nc6 6. g3 Nf6 7. Bg2 Be7 8. Bg5 a6 *

title: Rook Pin Wins the Knight
story: Black's knight sits proudly on e4 — but the king behind it has not castled. Pin it and pile on!
pgn: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nf6 3. d4 Nxe4 4. Bd3 d5 5. Nxe5 Nd7 6. Nxd7 Bxd7 7. O-O Bd6 8. c4 c6 *

title: Freeze the Knight, Win the Game
story: White's knight stands right in front of the queen. Slide your bishop out and freeze it — then keep piling on the pressure until it falls!
pgn: 1. e4 e5 2. Nc3 Nf6 3. g3 d5 4. exd5 Nxd5 5. Bg2 Nxc3 6. bxc3 Bd6 7. Nf3 O-O 8. O-O Nc6 9. Re1 Re8 10. d3 h6 11. Be3 Bg4 *
